verdict.rationale: Osborne Clarke documents a dedicated data analytics, protection and privacy practice that resolves privacy and data protection issues across European jurisdictions, plus a cyber security practice covering cyber incidents. This directly matches a documented privacy/cyber practice. However, the evidence never names a specific regime (GDPR, CCPA, DPDP) and has no independent corroboration. missing for 10: explicit naming of the regulatory regimes advised on (GDPR, CCPA, DPDP or equivalents), evidence of compliance-counselling scope beyond Europe, independent or third-party corroboration of the practice.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, the firm counsels on privacy and data-protection compliance (GDPR, CCPA, India's DPDP Act, or local equivalents) through a documented privacy/cyber practice

citations.quote: Our team of experienced lawyers takes the headache out of resolving privacy and data protection law issues in Europe's trickiest jurisdictions.
we help clients take advantage of the ever-growing number of opportunities to make the most of their data, particularly when it comes to commercialising it compliantly.
Our international team advises across the full spectrum of cyber-related issues, ensuring you are well-prepared to anticipate, respond to, and recover from cyber incidents.
